choices.text: Use the new tool on all three trucks, even if it slows your work today.
Use the old setup today and learn the tablet on a slow afternoon.
Use the tablet on one truck with Pao beside you, comparing results.

response.text: The shop in Manteca just bought a diagnostic tablet with guided tests and remote support. Pao says it is slower than his old laptop setup. Three trucks are waiting this afternoon.
response.title: The new scan tool in Manteca
